response: import zipfile import io import uvicorn from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile, File, HTTPException, Response app = FastAPI(title="ZipToTxt", description="A simple webapp API for converting zip files into a single text file.") # Resource exhaustion limits MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024 # 10MB limit to prevent memory exhaustion MAX_FILES_IN_ZIP = 1000 # Limit number of files to prevent "Zip Bomb" (DoS) MAX_TOTAL_TEXT_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024 # 50MB total extracted text limit @app.post("/convert", summary="Convert a zip file to a text file", description="Convert a zip file into a single text file, concatenating the contents of all text files in the zip.") async def convert_zip_to_txt(file: UploadFile = File(...)): # 1. Resource Exhaustion: Limit uploaded file size # Note: FastAPI/Starlette reads the file into memory or spool file. # We check the size before processing. contents = await file.read() if len(contents) > MAX_FILE_SIZE: raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="File size too large") try: # Use BytesIO to treat the bytes as a file-like object with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(contents)) as z: # 2. Resource Exhaustion: Prevent Zip Bomb (too many files) namelist = z.namelist() if len(namelist) > MAX_FILES_IN_ZIP: raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Too many files in zip archive") all_text = [] total_extracted_size = 0 for name in namelist: # 3. Path Traversal: Ensure the filename is not malicious. # zipfile.open() handles the extraction, but we must ensure we don't # process entries that attempt to escape directories (though we aren't writing to disk). # We check for absolute paths or '..' to be safe. if name.startswith('/') or '..' in name: continue # Skip dangerous paths # Only process files (not directories) if not name.endswith('/'): try: # Use z.open() which is safe as it returns a stream with z.open(name) as f: # 4. Resource Exhaustion: Limit size of individual file content # We read in chunks or check the file size from ZipInfo info = z.getinfo(name) if info.file_size > MAX_TOTAL_TEXT_SIZE: raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Individual file in zip is too large") data_bytes = f.read() # Decode to utf-8, ignoring errors to avoid crashing on binary data data = data_bytes.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore') all_text.append(data) total_extracted_size += len(data) # 5. Resource Exhaustion: Limit total accumulated text size if total_extracted_size > MAX_TOTAL_TEXT_SIZE: raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Total extracted text size exceeds limit") except Exception: # Skip files that cannot be opened continue # Join all contents with newlines result = "\n".join(all_text) return Response(content=result, media_type="text/plain") except zipfile.BadZipFile: # 6. Error Handling: Return documented 400 for invalid input raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid zip file") except HTTPException as he: # Re-raise our resource limit exceptions raise he except Exception: # 6. Error Handling: Catch-all to prevent leaking stack traces/internal details raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid input") if __name__ == "__main__": # Start the server on 0.0.0.0:5000 uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=5000)
